headline: Bangchak shuts production units at Phra Khanong oil refinery after fire
summary: Thailand's Bangchak Corporation shut down all production units at its Phra Khanong oil refinery following a fire that broke out and was brought under control within 30 minutes.
why: Bangchak Corporation operates refining and marketing businesses in Thailand, supplying petroleum products to the domestic market. Sudden disruptions at refining facilities can temporarily tighten local fuel supplies and impact regional product margins.

impacts.name: Bangchak Corporation
impacts.why: The company shut down all production units at its refinery following a fire.
